Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Is watching a bright screen (computer/TV) in the dark damaging to your eyes?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine your eyes are like little cameras. When you look at a bright screen in the dark, your eyes have to work extra hard, just like how it’s harder to see when it’s really dark outside and someone turns on a flashlight in your face.

Looking at a bright screen in the dark for a long time can make your eyes tired and maybe give you a headache. But it won’t break your eyes or make you go blind. It’s just not as comfy for your eyes. It’s better to have some soft light around when you look at screens, so your eyes don’t get so tired.
